$comment: Reference config for a repo that checks in generated API surfaces. Copy to .seamux/restack.json and replace the commands with the ones CI actually runs — a paraphrase of a CI step is a check that passes locally and fails in the pipeline.

artifacts.name: grpc-clients
artifacts.breaks: CI regenerates and asserts no diff

artifacts.name: graphql-schema
artifacts.regen: docker compose run --rm app bundle exec rake graphql:dump
artifacts.note: needs the app container; during a walk this is resolved to the base copy and recorded stale

artifacts.name: db-schema
artifacts.note: not regenerable without a migrated database. take-base keeps the base copy; re-running your own migration re-adds your lines, and that is a commit you make deliberately.

artifacts.name: js-lockfile
artifacts.note: then re-resolve dependencies; a hand-merged lockfile locks nothing

checks.name: proto-breaking
checks.note: the same comparison the pipeline makes

checks.name: graphql-breaking
checks.run: git show origin/master:app/graphql/schema.graphql > /tmp/base-schema.graphql && docker compose run --rm app bundle exec schema_comparator verify /tmp/base-schema.graphql app/graphql/schema.graphql
